units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> <he>יום ת׳ היה וכ׳</he> (not <he>תיאטי׳</he>) it was spectacle day, and all went to see (the show), but he (Joseph) did not go; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>, beg. <cite ref="I00292"><he>טיאטרון</he></cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Pesik. R. s. 6</cite> <he>יום ת׳ וקורקסין</he> (not <he>וקורקסיו</he>) a day of theatre and circus performances. Cant. R. l. c. <he>יום ט׳ של נילוס</he> the show day for the Nile festival, v. <cite ref="G00265"><he>זִיבּוּל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:7:2">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ</cite> <he>העולה לת׳ אסור וכ׳</he> to go to theatre is forbidden on account of idolatry (which is practiced in it); <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:5">Tosef. ib. II, 5</cite> <he>לתרטיאות של גוים</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>לתרטאיות</he>, <he>לסרטאיות</he>, read: <he>לתִיאַטְרָאוֹת</he> pl.). Y.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:5">ib.</cite> l. c. <he>העולה לת׳ וצווח וכ׳</he> to go to a theatre and cry out (to vote for a broken down gladiator &c.), if it is for the public benefit, is permitted.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51">Ex. R. s. 51</cite>, end <he>ראה אותם גובין לתְיַטְרוֹן</he> he saw that they were collecting for the erection of a theatre. Y. Taan. II, 64ᵃ bot. <he>תייט׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U01799"><he>שְׁפַר</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>תִּיאַטְרָאוֹת</he>, <he>תִּיאַטְרָיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Megillah 6a:14">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ וקרקסיות</he> Ar. (ed. <he>תראטדיות</he>, <he>תרטר׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>טרטסיאות</he>) theatres and circuses. Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Sh’moth 6 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 1:7">Ex. I, 7</cite>) <he>שנתמלאו בתי טרטיאות וכ׳</he> the theatres and circuses were full of them; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 162">Yalk. Ex. 162</cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:9">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אין הולכין לטרטיאות וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>טרטסיאות</he>) you must not go to the gentile theatres and circuses, because &c., v. <cite ref="G00044"><he>זָבַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:2:2">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> <he>מודה</he> … <he>ולא נתת חלקי בבתי תְרַטְיוֹת וכ׳</he> I thank thee … that thou hast given me my share with those sitting in the schools and synagogues, and hast not given me my share in the theatres and circuses; a. fr.
